title: Integer powers of a projective-bundle tautological line have distinct local degrees
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E a quasi-coherent finite locally free module of constant rank r >= 2 [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], P = Proj_S(Sym E) and p:P->S [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra]. Let D be a normalized tautological quotient [lem-trf-projective-bundle-quotient-geometry]. If U is an open of S containing a point s and the restrictions to p^{-1}U of D.line^{tensor m} and D.line^{tensor n} are isomorphic, with the integer powers of [def-sfb-locally-constant-line-twist] and restriction by [def-pc-module-pullback], then m = n.

source.place: Remark 4.2.7, printed p.75; Stacks divisors.tex, Tag 0BXJ, field uniqueness of projective-space twists, with normalized projective-bundle quotient geometry and pullback of integer powers.

proof.text: Pull the displayed isomorphism back to the residue-field fibre over s. The canonical symmetric-algebra base change and tautological quotient construction identify this fibre and its line with the projective bundle and line of the r-dimensional residue vector space. The chart equations for D preserve the degree-one generator, so the identification applies to the specified normalized quotient.

source.place: Remark 4.2.7, printed p.75; Stacks divisors.tex, Tag 0BXJ, field uniqueness of projective-space twists, with normalized projective-bundle quotient geometry and pullback of integer powers.

proof.text: Pullback commutes with integer line powers: positive powers use the tensor comparison and negative powers use the inverse evaluation. The field part of local normal form applied to the residue-field bundle therefore sees both m and n as its unique integer exponent; hence they coincide. The assumption r>=2 gives positive projective dimension, and s in U rules out the vacuous empty neighbourhood.

theorem projective_bundle_integer_twist_separation (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules)
    [E.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r] (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (D : TautologicalQuotient E) (U : S.Opens) (s : S) (hs : s ∈ U) (m n : ℤ)
    (e : Nonempty ((tensorPullback
      ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj
        (integerLinePower D.line D.invertible m) ≅
      (tensorPullback
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj
        (integerLinePower D.line D.invertible n))) : m = n
